decision.summary: The screened region (690–729) exhibits sustained high-amplitude cross-axis fluctuations without a confirmed return to prior baseline. The sharp N drop at 724 does not constitute a full opposing return given lack of sustained reversal on N/E/U and absence of post-724 recovery within allowed context [655,729]. No other temporary offsets identified in the allowed context.

intervals.observation: N/E/U show elevated variability from index 690 onward: N ~6–10, E ~7–13, U ~-3.5 to +0.5; no clear return to pre-690 baseline observed within allowed context. A sharp N drop at 724 (10.26→7.39) occurs but is not followed by sustained reversal or recovery in N/E/U; interior remains offset and noisy. Return phase unobserved/ambiguous.
